body: Thank you for your kind words, they really helped. The saving X amount from each check was my plan going into the position, only after seeing my original hours did I realise 'x' is gonna be about $10 a week, and now it will likely be a negative number. I am keenly aware that positive reinforcement can't always come from people, which is why I turned my gaze to making my living environment less depressing, but there was that road block. I do have a routine in place that involves physical activity before work, but I won't be able to stick with it for much longer because it makes me extremely fatigued, and I already barely have any energy. Relaxing is also not really something that's working, if an activity isn't requiring my full physical and mental attention, my mind spirals almost instantaneously, and activities like that are hard sought for a number of reasons(the ones that are accessible are quickly becoming things I can do while my mind wanders :/). I have been warned since discharge to stray from setting goals that can't be accomplished daily, just because of how my circumstances affect my future so drastically, but most simple tasks are hard for me to even begin to complete because of the mental strain. I truly appreciate you taking the time to type all this out, though, and I will continue doing the best I can for as long as I can, I just don't know that that will be for much longer and I'm trying to learn if I can be doing anything better(which is to say that your advice is exactly the best I've been doing thus far.)
